name: Cyrus Bell
want: a farm of his own in Oregon, on land no one can take from him
secret: He killed the overseer who caught him escaping from Missouri in 1862, and still fears someone from home will recognise him.
voice: Slow and deliberate; says a thing once.
description: Born enslaved in Missouri, he escaped to Kansas during the war and worked as a blacksmith for the army. His forge wagon keeps the company's wheels turning.
appearance: Broad, scarred forearms, a leather apron he wears even at supper.
